/** saleson.shop.lclgvHnrUser.LclgvHnrUserMngMapper.selectLclgvHnrUserMngDetail 지자체 명예 사용자 상세 페이지 조회 */ SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY LCLGV_CD) AS ROW_NUMBER , A.LCLGV_CD , GL.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM || ' ' || GL.LOCGOV_NM AS LCLGV_CD_NM , A.GLD_GRD_DNTN_AMT , A.SLVR_GRD_DNTN_AMT , A.BRNZ_GRD_DNTN_AMT , A.HNR_USER_STNG_TTL , A.HNR_USER_RWRD , A.RPRS_IMG_NM , A.HNR_USER_SLCTN_SE_CD , B.LABEL AS HNR_USER_SLCTN_SE_CD_NM , A.USE_YN , A.LAST_REG_DT , A.LAST_RGTR_ID FROM G_LCLGV_HNR_USER_STNG_MNG A, OP_COMMON_CODE B, G_LOCGOV GL WHERE A.HNR_USER_SLCTN_SE_CD = B.ID(+) AND A.LCLGV_CD = GL.LOCGOV_CODE(+)
AND LCLGV_CD = #{lclgvCd}

/** saleson.shop.lclgvHnrUser.LclgvHnrUserMngMapper.getHnrUserInfoList 회원 기준 명예시도민증 목록 조회 */ SELECT CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE AS LCLGV_CD , LOCGOV_NM AS LCLGV_NM , HNR_USER_SLCTN_SE_CD /*, CASE WHEN HNR_CNTR_CRTR_AMT >= GLD_GRD_DNTN_AMT THEN 'GOLD' WHEN HNR_CNTR_CRTR_AMT >= SLVR_GRD_DNTN_AMT THEN 'SILVER' ELSE 'BRONZE' END AS HNR_GRD*/ , 'BRONZE' AS HNR_GRD , EXPIRED_DATE AS EXPIRED_DATE , HNR_CNTR_CRTR_AMT /*, GLD_GRD_DNTN_AMT , SLVR_GRD_DNTN_AMT*/ , BRNZ_GRD_DNTN_AMT , OCC.DETAIL AS HNR_USER_SLCTN_SE_DTL , HNR_USER_RWRD , HNR_USER_STNG_TTL , RPRS_IMG_NM , NOW_CNTR_START_EXPIRED_DATE FROM ( SELECT T_A.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE , T_A.LOCGOV_NM , CASE WHEN T_A.HNR_USER_SLCTN_SE_CD = 'JEJU_REQ_CRTR' THEN MIN(CNTR_SUM) OVER (PARTITION BY CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE, CNTR_YEAR) WHEN T_A.HNR_USER_SLCTN_SE_CD = 'BF_YR_1YR' THEN MAX(BF_1YR_AMT) OVER (PARTITION BY CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE, CNTR_YEAR) WHEN T_A.HNR_USER_SLCTN_SE_CD = 'NOW_CRTR_1YR_WTHN' THEN MAX(NOW_1YR_AMT) OVER (PARTITION BY CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE, CNTR_YEAR) ELSE 0 END AS HNR_CNTR_CRTR_AMT , T_A.HNR_USER_SLCTN_SE_CD , CASE WHEN T_A.HNR_USER_SLCTN_SE_CD = 'BF_YR_1YR' THEN YEAR(SYSDATE) || '1231' WHEN T_A.HNR_USER_SLCTN_SE_CD = 'JEJU_REQ_CRTR' AND JEJU_EXPIRED_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(MAX(JEJU_EXPIRED_DATE), 'yyyyMMdd'), 12), -1), '%Y%m%d') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(T_A.JEJU_EXPIRED_DATE,'yyyyMMdd'), 12), -1), '%Y%m%d') END AS EXPIRED_DATE -- , MAX(T_A.CNTR_DE) AS NOW_CNTR_START_EXPIRED_DATE , MIN(CASE WHEN T_A.CNTR_SUM2 >= T_A.BRNZ_GRD_DNTN_AMT THEN T_A.CNTR_DE END) AS NOW_CNTR_START_EXPIRED_DATE /*, T_A.GLD_GRD_DNTN_AMT , T_A.SLVR_GRD_DNTN_AMT*/ , T_A.BRNZ_GRD_DNTN_AMT , T_A.NOW_1YR_AMT , T_A.BF_1YR_AMT , T_A.HNR_USER_RWRD , T_A.HNR_USER_STNG_TTL , T_A.RPRS_IMG_NM FROM ( SELECT * , CASE WHEN HNR_USER_SLCTN_SE_CD = 'NOW_CRTR_1YR_WTHN' THEN CASE WHEN IS_WITH_IN = 'Y' THEN NOW_1YR_MIN_CNTR_DE ELSE NULL END ELSE CASE WHEN JEJU_CHECK >= MIN_JEJU_CHECK THEN CNTR_DE ELSE NULL END END AS JEJU_EXPIRED_DATE FROM ( SELECT * , MIN(JEJU_CHECK) OVER (PARTITION BY CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE) AS MIN_JEJU_CHECK , MIN(CASE WHEN HNR_USER_SLCTN_SE_CD = 'NOW_CRTR_1YR_WTHN' AND IS_WITH_IN = 'Y' THEN CNTR_DE END) OVER(PARTITION BY CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE) AS NOW_1YR_MIN_CNTR_DE FROM ( SELECT * , CASE WHEN JEJU_CHECK_AMT - BRNZ_GRD_DNTN_AMT < 0 THEN 9999999999 ELSE JEJU_CHECK_AMT - BRNZ_GRD_DNTN_AMT END AS JEJU_CHECK , SUM(CASE WHEN IS_WITH_IN = 'Y' THEN CNTR_AMT ELSE 0 END ) OVER (PARTITION BY CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE ORDER BY CNTR_DE) AS CNTR_SUM2 from ( SELECT C.CNTR_SN , C.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE , L.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM || ' ' || L.LOCGOV_NM AS LOCGOV_NM , C.CNTR_DE , C.CNTR_AMT , SUM(C.CNTR_AMT) OVER (PARTITION BY C.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE, DATE_FORMAT(TO_DATE(CNTR_DE, 'yyyyMMdd'), '%Y') ORDER BY C.CNTR_DE) AS CNTR_SUM /* , CASE WHEN HU.HNR_USER_SLCTN_SE_CD = 'JEJU_REQ_CRTR' THEN 9999999999 ELSE NVL(HU.GLD_GRD_DNTN_AMT, 9999999999) END AS GLD_GRD_DNTN_AMT , CASE WHEN HU.HNR_USER_SLCTN_SE_CD = 'JEJU_REQ_CRTR' THEN 9999999999 ELSE NVL(HU.SLVR_GRD_DNTN_AMT, 9999999999) END AS SLVR_GRD_DNTN_AMT , CASE WHEN HU.HNR_USER_SLCTN_SE_CD = 'JEJU_REQ_CRTR' THEN 100000 ELSE NVL(HU.BRNZ_GRD_DNTN_AMT, 9999999999) END AS BRNZ_GRD_DNTN_AMT */ , NVL(HU.BRNZ_GRD_DNTN_AMT, 9999999999) AS BRNZ_GRD_DNTN_AMT , CASE WHEN HU.HNR_USER_SLCTN_SE_CD = 'JEJU_REQ_CRTR' THEN DATE_FORMAT(TO_DATE(C.CNTR_DE, 'yyyyMMdd'), '%Y') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -12), '%Y') END AS CNTR_YEAR , HU.HNR_USER_SLCTN_SE_CD , SUM(CASE WHEN C.CNTR_DE <= DATE_FORMAT(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -12), '%Y%m%d') THEN 0 ELSE C.CNTR_AMT END) OVER (PARTITION BY C.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE) AS NOW_1YR_AMT , SUM(CASE WHEN C.CNTR_DE <= (DATE_FORMAT(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -12), '%Y') || '1231') AND C.CNTR_DE >= (DATE_FORMAT(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -12), '%Y') || '0101') THEN C.CNTR_AMT ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY C.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE) AS BF_1YR_AMT , CASE WHEN HU.HNR_USER_SLCTN_SE_CD = 'NOW_CRTR_1YR_WTHN' THEN CASE WHEN C.CNTR_DE <= DATE_FORMAT(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -12), '%Y%m%d') THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END WHEN HU.HNR_USER_SLCTN_SE_CD = 'BF_YR_1YR' THEN CASE WHEN C.CNTR_DE <= (DATE_FORMAT(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -12), '%Y') || '1231') AND C.CNTR_DE >= (DATE_FORMAT(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -12), '%Y') || '0101') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END ELSE 'Y' END AS IS_WITH_IN , HU.HNR_USER_RWRD , HU.HNR_USER_STNG_TTL , HU.RPRS_IMG_NM , SUM(C.CNTR_AMT) OVER (PARTITION BY C.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE, SUBSTR(C.CNTR_DE, 1,4) ORDER BY C.CNTR_DE) AS JEJU_CHECK_AMT FROM G_CNTR C LEFT JOIN G_LOCGOV L ON C.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = L.LOCGOV_CODE LEFT JOIN G_LCLGV_HNR_USER_STNG_MNG HU ON HU.LCLGV_CD = C.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE AND USE_YN = 'Y' /*AND GLD_GRD_DNTN_AMT > 0 AND SLVR_GRD_DNTN_AMT > 0*/ AND BRNZ_GRD_DNTN_AMT > 0 WHERE 1 = 1 AND C.USER_ID = #{userId} AND C.USER_ID > 0 AND C.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND C.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND C.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND C.CNTR_DE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -12), '%Y') || '0101' AND DATE_FORMAT(SYSDATE, '%Y') || '1231' ORDER BY C.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE, C.CNTR_DE ) ) ) ) T_A WHERE T_A.HNR_USER_SLCTN_SE_CD IS NOT NULL AND ((T_A.HNR_USER_SLCTN_SE_CD <> 'NOW_CRTR_1YR_WTHN' AND T_A.CNTR_SUM >= T_A.BRNZ_GRD_DNTN_AMT) OR (T_A.HNR_USER_SLCTN_SE_CD = 'NOW_CRTR_1YR_WTHN' AND T_A.CNTR_SUM2 >= T_A.BRNZ_GRD_DNTN_AMT)) --AND T_A.CNTR_SUM >= T_A.BRNZ_GRD_DNTN_AMT AND T_A.IS_WITH_IN = 'Y' GROUP BY T_A.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE, T_A.CNTR_YEAR
) T_B LEFT JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE OCC ON OCC.CODE_TYPE = 'HNR_USER_SLCTN_SE_CD' AND OCC.ID = HNR_USER_SLCTN_SE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND T_B.HNR_CNTR_CRTR_AMT >= BRNZ_GRD_DNTN_AMT AND T_B.EXPIRED_DATE >= DATE_FORMAT(SYSDATE, '%Y%m%d') GROUP BY T_B.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE ORDER BY T_B.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE
